io.milvus.bulkwriter.common.utils

Class GeneratorUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.common.utils.GeneratorUtils

  • public class GeneratorUtils
extends Object
    Utility class that generates sample values for the various Milvus field data types, used when producing bulk data files for testing or examples.
